headline: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva Secures Fourth Presidential Term in Brazil Runoff
summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated right-wing senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff to secure a fourth non-consecutive term, confronting major economic challenges in Latin America's largest economy.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy and a major global exporter of agricultural commodities and crude oil. Presidential leadership directly steers fiscal, monetary, and regulatory policy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Political continuity avoids regime change uncertainty but challenges remain over fiscal spending and debt levels.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Currency markets typically react to post-election fiscal policy expectations and fiscal framework sustainability.

why_moved: Lula's victory resolves election uncertainty but refocuses investor attention on fiscal policy and deficit containment in Brazil.
